risk_narrative: Rule GRACE-PERIOD-RULE produces no divergence and is backed by an explicit 1994 change request specifying the exact 30-day and 5-year thresholds; migration risk is low, but the business stakeholder who approved that threshold should confirm whether the values remain current.

Rule ORPHAN-RULE diverges in 18 of 18 firings across all 6 years of production history: the modernized translation silently drops the end-of-quarter payout adjustment entirely, yet no documentation exists anywhere in the available records explaining why this adjustment was introduced or whether it is still required — making this the highest-risk finding in this migration.
